UNDERSTAND THE PRODUCT

Product description

99% Europe quality99% Singapore quality

Also known as: Saunf / Variari
Botanical name: Foeniculum vulgare Mill.

Fennel is an aromatic whole spice with elongated, ridged seeds. Buyers often compare colour, seed size, cleaning and aroma. These characteristics should be agreed from a specification and, where needed, a representative sample.

Europe quality and Singapore quality are listed commercial grade options. Required purity results, other quality limits and destination compliance are confirmed for the offered lot. These spice grades do not establish germination or suitability for sowing. For a planting enquiry, specify the variety, growing region and required lot-specific seed tests separately.

Mehsana and the Unjha spice market

Our business is based in Mehsana, North Gujarat, near Unjha’s established cumin and fennel trading market. Compare origin, crop year and a representative sample when assessing an offer.

Market context: APMC Unjha describes its cumin and fennel trade ↗.

Common applications

Seasoning blends; food ingredients; spice distribution; grinding.

Specification status

PRACTICAL BUYING DETAILS

Before you choose a lot.

Match the product, specification and commercial terms.

Product questions

Which fennel details should I compare?

Compare the same commercial quality label, colour reference, seed-size or sieve requirement, purity and aroma. Our listed options are 99% Europe quality and 99% Singapore quality; approve the detailed lot specification separately.

Are colour and aroma the same quality measure?

No. A visual colour preference does not define aroma or volatile-oil results. Explain the intended application and agree both appearance and analytical requirements where needed.

What is the minimum order quantity?

Our listed minimum order is 1 metric tonne. Confirm your grade, packing and destination with the quotation.

Can I request a sample and lot report?

Samples are available without a product charge; shipping costs apply. State the sample quantity and required tests. Lot reports and dispatch arrangements are confirmed for the proposed offer.

Which loading port and shipment lead time apply?

Indian loading ports can be arranged with the quotation. Usual preparation is 10–15 days after order confirmation; final dispatch depends on the agreed specification, documents and freight arrangements.

Which payment terms are available?

T/T, L/C and PayPal are listed payment options. The payment schedule, currency and method must be agreed in the quotation before an order is confirmed.
